sections_checked: Fig. 1; Procedures; change of analysis plan; Statistical methods; availability
finding: 463094 screened minus 1276 exclusions equals 461818 analyzed; self-selection required revised adjustment.
limitation: Observational exposure and proprietary detector; adjusted effects need the released analysis environment, not a raw-rate comparison.
project_action: Resolve denominator note; distinguish outcome-analysis reproduction from detector training.

sections_checked: Institutional structured abstract; protocol-defined secondary outcomes
finding: Randomized screening comparison; published arm counts and workload totals permit arithmetic checks.
limitation: Full article not obtained; no participant-level reanalysis or Transpara execution.
project_action: Retain abstract review; verify rounded rates and preserve the shared MASAI trial family.

sections_checked: Institutional structured abstract; primary outcome and margin
finding: Reported interval-cancer ratio CI is compared with the prespecified 20 percent noninferiority margin.
limitation: Full article not obtained; noninferiority does not demonstrate a reduction in interval cancers.
project_action: Retain abstract review and avoid superiority language for the primary interval-cancer endpoint.

sections_checked: Methods; cohort construction; risk-guideline evaluation; statistical analysis
finding: Repeated examinations, follow-up eligibility and all-Hologic imaging constrain the transported risk claim.
limitation: Several cohorts were analyzed previously; seven sites do not establish universal device transportability.
project_action: Add follow-up, repeat-examination and device restrictions to the risk-model interpretation.

sections_checked: Cohort design; multi-source CV; clinical/pathology combination; availability
finding: Development-source validation selects settings; five external cohorts support the stated external assessment.
limitation: Proprietary full model; retrospective prognosis is not individualized treatment-effect estimation.
project_action: Retain external-cohort boundary and separate frozen evaluation from development calibration.

sections_checked: Predictor architecture; training/testing; cleaning; feature importance; availability
finding: 1000-trial randomized fivefold searches and repeated-seed ensembles are explicitly described.
limitation: Controlled molecular data and legacy dependencies remain necessary; feature-drop scores are not causal effects.
project_action: Add complete-data denominator and distinguish the article ensemble from the selected source file.

sections_checked: Patients; integrated prediction model; validation; availability
finding: Development-cohort tenfold tuning is followed by three external datasets; the linked source belongs to a partly different implementation history.
limitation: Data on request and incomplete code-to-paper coverage block an end-to-end reproduction.
project_action: Retain release-mismatch caveat and do not treat the nonsignificant immune increment as established.

sections_checked: Methods 4.6-4.9; supplementary Algorithms 1-2; component-count sensitivity
finding: Development includes source-held-out tuning and calibration; external component-count sweeps are explicitly post hoc.
limitation: Preprint; external exploratory sweeps must not be treated as untouched confirmatory model selection.
project_action: Upgrade selected-method review, retain preprint status and flag post hoc evaluation reuse.

sections_checked: Selection-bias discussion; external CV; cancer examples
finding: Gene selection must be repeated inside resampling to assess the resulting procedure.
limitation: Colon/leukemia examples are not breast cancer validation.
project_action: Maintain training-only selection; no reanalysis of the original datasets.

sections_checked: Checklist table; development/evaluation distinctions; performance reporting
finding: Reporting asks for targets, predictors, missingness, evaluation and model access in a structured way.
limitation: Reading a checklist is not a completed reporting-compliance assessment.
project_action: Use reporting prompts without attaching a compliance label.

sections_checked: Tool domains; development/evaluation distinctions; analysis considerations
finding: Quality, risk of bias and applicability are distinct assessment questions.
limitation: No complete signalling-question assessment was performed for any clinical paper.
project_action: Record unresolved design questions; do not assign unsupported low-risk ratings.

sections_checked: Simulation methods; null/non-null data; nested CV comparison
finding: Tuning-score optimism is separated from an outer assessment of the selection procedure.
limitation: Synthetic simulation results are not a clinical uncertainty guarantee.
project_action: Test boundaries and candidate selection without claiming paper-result replication.

sections_checked: Selection-criterion variance; evaluation bias; experiments
finding: A noisy selection criterion can be overfit even if it is approximately unbiased before selection.
limitation: Different algorithms and sample designs can change the magnitude of the effect.
project_action: Count analyst and model-family choices in addition to grid rows.

sections_checked: Hyperparameter problem; validation/test distinction; experiments
finding: Random search allocates trials differently and its comparison includes configuration-search cost.
limitation: A larger original search space is different from our six-point grid.
project_action: Use random search as a future budgeted comparator, not an automatic improvement.

sections_checked: GP objective; acquisition functions; cost-aware optimization
finding: Expected improvement per unit cost adds an explicit experiment-duration model.
limitation: Cost modeling assumptions and optimizer overhead matter; no assay benchmark was run.
project_action: Keep objective and timing ledgers before adopting sequential optimization.

sections_checked: Successive Halving; Hyperband resource allocation; empirical evaluation
finding: Resource allocation and stopping require a useful low-to-high-budget relationship.
limitation: A cheap fidelity can change the task or eliminate a late-improving configuration.
project_action: Define training resource inside patient-preserving partitions.

sections_checked: Variance components; overlapping CV; numerical experiments
finding: Fold dependence prevents a universal unbiased estimator under the stated framework.
limitation: The result does not forbid every justified uncertainty procedure.
project_action: Keep fold spread descriptive and specify an estimand for patient-level uncertainty.

sections_checked: Evaluation; overtuning; pipelines; practical HPO guidance
finding: Search design, preprocessing choices and evaluation form a single development procedure.
limitation: Review synthesis does not select the best optimizer for our data.
project_action: Replace the old unavailable-full-text note with the author-hosted full-text review.

sections_checked: Container design; reproducibility convention; benchmark evaluation
finding: Container isolation supports benchmark replay but does not itself replicate optimizer-level results.
limitation: Seeds, hardware and benchmark representation remain part of the comparison.
project_action: Separate environment reproducibility from generalization evidence.

sections_checked: DE population updates; Hyperband scheduling; experiments
finding: DEHB couples evolving configurations to successive resource levels.
limitation: Reported speedups depend on the benchmark and resource definition.
project_action: Do not transport benchmark speedup numbers into a clinical-training claim.

sections_checked: Benchmark requirements; surrogate representation; reproducibility
finding: Fixed spaces, objectives and fidelity schedules are part of the benchmark contract.
limitation: Surrogates and tabular lookup can rank optimizers differently.
project_action: Preserve the measurement contract when comparing budget schedules.

sections_checked: Conditional spaces; facades; software design; current pinned example
finding: The paper supports conditional algorithm spaces; the current example explicitly validates defaults and incumbents.
limitation: The inspected 2026 API is not the frozen 2022 paper implementation.
project_action: Pin code and compare a declared default under the same assessment design.

sections_checked: Prior construction; good/bad priors; robustness experiments
finding: Prior quality and budget horizons are deliberately varied in the experiments.
limitation: Engineered benchmark priors are not verified biomedical expert priors.
project_action: Assess prior-guided and unguided search under a common budget.

sections_checked: Meta-train/meta-test split; preprocessing; aggregate scores
finding: Defaults are developed on separate datasets; numerical-missing rows are removed in the benchmark.
limitation: This excludes a missing-data problem central to assay workflows.
project_action: Retain imputation and person grouping instead of importing benchmark row exclusions.

sections_checked: Stored predictions; portfolio transfer; ensemble evaluation; limitations
finding: Precomputed predictions support retrospective model/ensemble comparisons at low additional fitting cost.
limitation: Adaptive reuse and dataset overlap still require an assessment boundary.
project_action: Keep prediction provenance; no ensemble was fitted in our project.

sections_checked: Overtuning definition; benchmark reanalysis; limitations
finding: Validation improvement and generalization change are separately defined and analyzed.
limitation: The benchmark frequency is not a breast cancer failure probability.
project_action: Assess the complete search procedure rather than its best inner score.

sections_checked: Evaluation protocol; validation ablation; result artifacts
finding: Ensembling, search budgets and validation design alter model-family conclusions.
limitation: Living repositories can diverge from the publication; compute costs remain substantial.
project_action: Declare hardware and budgets before cross-family comparisons.

sections_checked: Experiments; nested evaluation; package roles; selected pinned R source
finding: The filter graph is resampled inside outer training data, with selection and fit records retained.
limitation: Full-data ranking is a separate similarity analysis; complete-data survival examples are not paired classifiers.
project_action: Adapt the pipeline mechanism only; source and paper results were not executed.

sections_checked: Indexed abstract; author-institution bibliographic record
finding: The paper jointly evaluates accuracy, panel size and stability on cancer transcriptomes.
limitation: Full methods not obtained; cohort independence and code remain unverified.
project_action: Retain abstract review and avoid adopting the reported panel.

sections_checked: Publisher sections 2.1-2.3; sample-size framework
finding: Observed/expected ratio and calibration slope assess different aspects; validation precision is endpoint-specific.
limitation: No formula implementation was checked; paired specimens need additional dependence treatment.
project_action: Plan external validation separately from development fitting counts.

sections_checked: Sections 2-3; horizon-specific calibration; simulation assumptions
finding: A survival validation calculation requires horizon, predictor distribution and censoring/event assumptions.
limitation: No simulation was executed; a generic event-count rule cannot replace the stated design assumptions.
project_action: Require time zero and horizon before sizing a prognosis assessment.

sections_checked: Data bias; circular analysis; repeated adaptation; recommendations
finding: Dataset choice and repeated assessment-driven changes can undermine clinical relevance.
limitation: A methodological review is not an external validation of any breast predictor.
project_action: Audit source availability, patient/site boundaries and intended use together.

sections_checked: Leakage taxonomy; info sheets; case-study design
finding: Upstream features, sampling and target availability belong in the information-flow audit.
limitation: Case-study corrections do not estimate error prevalence in breast cancer research.
project_action: Keep a claim-specific data-flow record and implementation evidence.

sections_checked: Dataset criteria; random-search ordering; validation/test protocol
finding: The comparison distinguishes search-selected validation configurations from test assessment.
limitation: Small and high-dimensional assay cohorts differ from the benchmark inclusion setting.
project_action: Preserve simple and tree-based baselines when testing newer learners.

sections_checked: Synthetic pretraining; attention architecture; limitations and compute
finding: The paper limits its evaluation scale and describes test-to-training attention without test-label context.
limitation: No checkpoint, current license or pretrained-data audit was completed.
project_action: Keep checkpoint identity, context labels and inference costs explicit.

sections_checked: Sections 3.3-3.5; failure policy; source setup; processed scores
finding: Failures/timeouts are handled with a Kaplan-Meier fallback in the published benchmark protocol.
limitation: Raw refit objects are omitted; processed output checks do not reproduce inferential tests or training.
project_action: Audit missing metrics by objective and preserve failure flags before any ranking comparison.
